technical.summary: Strong uptrend structure with price above all major MAs and new highs, but extreme overbought conditions across RSI, Stochastic, and MFI create elevated pullback risk; best suited for profit-taking or tight-stop entries rather than aggressive swing initiation.

fundamental.summary: ALB shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 14 days present elevated risk with no supporting fundamental catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Weak bullish signal from junior Democratic representative's small purchases 90+ days ago; neutral market sentiment with no news data to confirm conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (175.68) indicates extreme market stress, FOMC event today adds binary risk, and earnings in 14 days compounds volatility for Materials sector.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price at 52-week highs with supertrend bullish, all major MAs bullish, and new 20-day highs suggest structural uptrend continuation with defined support at 261.60.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions (RSI 9/14, Stochastic 88.77, MFI) combined with zero fundamental support, high earnings risk in 14 days, VIX crisis levels, inverted yield curve, and FOMC event today create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Not applicable — macro and fundamental headwinds outweigh technical strength; existing ALB position should be managed for exits, not additions.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis levels (175.68), inverted yield curve, FOMC event today, and earnings in 14 days create compounding binary risks that invalidate swing trade risk/reward; extreme overbought technicals offer no margin of safety.
decision.recommended_exit: Manage existing ALB position with trailing_15pct or next_pivot_target; do not initiate new entry.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical strength contradicted by fundamental vacuum, macro crisis, and earnings proximity.
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding ALB with 33 open Materials positions (8.4% sector concentration); adding to either would violate concentration limits and earnings-proximity sizing rules.
